description: Erection of a part single part two storey rear extension and a part single part two storey side extension following demolition of the garage.  Erection of a rear roof extension with two front and one rear roof windows to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:ZAAVIA/24NC/401, ZAAVIA/24NC/402, ZAAVIA/24NC/403, ZAAVIA/24NC/404, ZAAVIA/24NC/405, ZAAVIA/24NC/406, ZAAVIA/24NC/407, ZAAVIA/24NC/408, ZAAVIA/24NC/409, ZAAVIA/24NC/410, ZAAVIA/24NC/411 ZAAVIA/24NC/412, Unnumbered Location Plan Received 14 July 2023

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Condition : 5 - The windows to be fitted on the front/rear roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed nd traditional, conservation-style.
